title: Stream operators for a Trade
hints: `<<`: `os << t.symbol << ' ' << (t.buy ? "BUY" : "SELL") << ' ' << t.qty << " @ "` then the price with 2 decimals. Restore the stream's flags afterwards, or format through an `std::ostringstream`.
`>>`: read `symbol side qty at price`, check that `at == "@"` and the side is valid, otherwise `is.setstate(std::ios::failbit)`.
Only modify `t` once everything has been read successfully.
